content.json:
# AFRL / DoD Personnel: Anthropic Access Compliance Monitoring
**Classification: TLP:AMBER (Internal use only)**

> DTS continuously monitors personnel on AFRL-funded projects for access to Anthropic-hosted AI services, using Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender telemetry, as an auditable compliance control. This workbook is the reporting and investigation view for that control. Start on **Executive Summary** for the current compliance posture, or jump to a specific tab above.
>
> First time here? See the **Setup & Validation** tab for data source requirements and how monitored personnel are maintained.

parameters.label: View

content.json:
## Monthly Compliance Dashboard
> Personnel and detection counts below use a fixed **current calendar month** window, independent of the time range selector, so this tile row matches whatever month you're reporting on. Detail tabs use the selector above.

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
ProjectUsers
| summarize ['Monitored Personnel'] = dcount(UserUPN)
content.title: Monitored Personnel

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
let ThisMonth = startofmonth(now());
union isfuzzy=true
    DeviceNetworkEvents,
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
               DeviceName:string) [])
| where Timestamp >= ThisMonth
| where RemoteUrl has_any (
    "claude.ai",
    "anthropic.com",
    "api.anthropic.com",
    "console.anthropic.com",
    "docs.anthropic.com",
    "support.anthropic.com")
| extend UserUPN = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
| where isnotempty(UserUPN)
| join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
| summarize ['Anthropic Detections'] = count()
content.title: Anthropic Detections (This Month)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where Title == "AFRL Anthropic Compliance"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(395d)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status !in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| summarize ['Open Investigations'] = dcount(IncidentNumber)
content.title: Open Investigations

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
let ThisMonth = startofmonth(now());
let AnthropicHits =
    union isfuzzy=true
        DeviceNetworkEvents,
        (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
                   DeviceName:string) [])
    | where Timestamp >= ThisMonth
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (
        "claude.ai",
    "anthropic.com",
    "api.anthropic.com",
    "console.anthropic.com",
    "docs.anthropic.com",
    "support.anthropic.com")
    | extend UserUPN = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN)
    | join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN;
let Detections = toscalar(AnthropicHits | summarize coalesce(count(), 0));
let OpenInvestigations = toscalar(
    union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
    | where Title == "AFRL Anthropic Compliance"
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(395d)
    | summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
    | where Status !in ("Closed", "Resolved")
    | summarize coalesce(dcount(IncidentNumber), 0));
print ['Compliance Status'] = case(
    Detections == 0, "🟢 Green",
    OpenInvestigations > 0, "🟠 Amber: Investigating",
    "🔴 Red: Unresolved Detection")
content.title: Compliance Status

content.json:
### Monthly Report Narrative (template)
> Copy-paste starting point: fill in the bracketed values from the tiles above (Monitored Personnel, Anthropic Detections, Compliance Status) and today's date. Not auto-generated, so it can't render oddly or drift from what KQL happens to compute; it's a template, not a substitute for analyst review.

> DTS continuously monitors **[Monitored Personnel]** personnel associated with AFRL-funded projects for access to Anthropic-hosted services using Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender telemetry. **[No access to Anthropic services was detected / N access event(s) were detected and are under review]** during **[Month Year]**. Monitoring coverage was reviewed and remains current as of **[today's date]**. The primary residual risk remains potential use of unmanaged personal devices or third-party platforms outside University visibility.

content.json:
### Residual Risks
- **Unmanaged personal devices**: activity from BYOD cannot be fully monitored; see the **Unmanaged Device Risk** tab for the current unmanaged-activity percentage.
- **Non-University networks**: off-network access (personal ISP, mobile data) bypasses on-prem network telemetry entirely; only endpoint-based signals (MDE) still see it.
- **Embedded Anthropic services within third-party products**: a third-party product that calls the Anthropic API server-side (not from the monitored user's device) will not appear in this monitoring and is a known blind spot.

    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
union isfuzzy=true
    DeviceNetworkEvents,
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
               DeviceName:string) [])
| where Timestamp {TimeRange}
| where RemoteUrl has_any (
    "claude.ai",
    "anthropic.com",
    "api.anthropic.com",
    "console.anthropic.com",
    "docs.anthropic.com",
    "support.anthropic.com")
| extend UserUPN = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
| where isnotempty(UserUPN)
| join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
| summarize Detections = count() by bin(Timestamp, 1d)
| sort by Timestamp asc
content.title: Anthropic Activity Timeline

content.json:
## Anthropic Access (Primary Control)
> Monitored domains: `claude.ai`, `anthropic.com`, `api.anthropic.com`, `console.anthropic.com`, `docs.anthropic.com`, `support.anthropic.com`. This list is intentionally hardcoded (not watchlist-driven) so the compliance control's scope can't drift from an unrelated, more loosely-curated domain list.
>
> **Outcome this answers:** were any monitored individuals observed accessing Anthropic services in the selected period?

content.json:
## AI Usage Context
> If a monitored individual states they used Claude, this tab shows what they actually accessed, covering OpenAI/ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Mistral, Poe and Hugging Face. The platform list is extensible on request.

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
let AIPlatforms = datatable(Domain:string, Platform:string) [
    "chatgpt.com",             "OpenAI / ChatGPT",
    "chat.openai.com",         "OpenAI / ChatGPT",
    "openai.com",              "OpenAI / ChatGPT",
    "copilot.microsoft.com",   "Microsoft Copilot",
    "copilot.cloud.microsoft", "Microsoft Copilot",
    "gemini.google.com",       "Google Gemini",
    "bard.google.com",         "Google Gemini",
    "perplexity.ai",           "Perplexity",
    "mistral.ai",              "Mistral",
    "chat.mistral.ai",         "Mistral",
    "poe.com",                 "Poe",
    "huggingface.co",          "Hugging Face"
];
let PlatformDomains = AIPlatforms | project Domain;
union isfuzzy=true
    DeviceNetworkEvents,
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
               DeviceName:string) [])
| where Timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend CleanHost = tolower(trim_start(@"www.", tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host)))
| where isnotempty(CleanHost)
| extend UserUPN = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
| where isnotempty(UserUPN)
| join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
| extend Domain2 = extract(@"([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})$", 1, CleanHost)
| extend Domain3 = extract(@"([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})$", 1, CleanHost)
| where Domain2 in (PlatformDomains) or Domain3 in (PlatformDomains)
| extend MatchDomain = iff(Domain3 in (PlatformDomains), Domain3, Domain2)
| join kind=inner AIPlatforms on $left.MatchDomain == $right.Domain
| summarize Events = count(), Users = dcount(UserUPN), LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by Platform
| sort by Events desc
content.title: Top AI Platforms Used

content.json:
## Monitored User Coverage
> **Outcome this answers:** can DTS demonstrate that all project personnel were included in monitoring? Sourced entirely from the `DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring` watchlist (`UserUPN`, `Name`, `Project`). This deployment's watchlist doesn't track a `Status`/`DateAdded`/`DateRemoved` history, so this tab shows current headcount and roster only; it can't show who was added or removed and when. Add those columns to the watchlist later if you want that history back; the workbook doesn't require it.

        Project     = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        LastUpdated = column_ifexists('LastUpdatedTimeUTC', column_ifexists('TimeGenerated', datetime(null)))

content.json:
## Detection Investigations
> **Outcome this answers:** what happened when activity was detected? Sourced from `SecurityIncident` for incidents raised by the **AFRL Anthropic Compliance** analytics rule. To record a reviewed-and-accepted detection as a compliance exception, add the incident label `ComplianceException` when closing it in Sentinel.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where Title == "AFRL Anthropic Compliance"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(395d)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize ['Investigations Opened'] = dcount(IncidentNumber)
content.title: Investigations Opened (Selected Period)

| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status in ("Closed", "Resolved") and ClosedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize ['Investigations Closed'] = dcount(IncidentNumber)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where Title == "AFRL Anthropic Compliance"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(395d)
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| mv-expand Labels
| where tostring(Labels.labelName) =~ "ComplianceException"
| summarize ['Compliance Exceptions'] = dcount(IncidentNumber)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where Title == "AFRL Anthropic Compliance"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(395d)

| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification,

| sort by CreatedTime desc
content.title: Investigation Detail

content.json:
## Known Devices
> **Outcome this answers:** are researchers using University-managed devices? `ManagedStatus` reflects whether the last-seen device is onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; presence there is a floor for "managed", not a guarantee of full Intune compliance (see **Unmanaged Device Risk** for the Entra sign-in compliance signal).

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
let Activity =
    union isfuzzy=true
        DeviceNetworkEvents,
        (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
                   DeviceName:string) [])
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange}
    | extend UserUPN = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN)
    | join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN;
let LastDevice = Activity
    | summarize (LastSeen, LastSeenDevice) = arg_max(Timestamp, DeviceName) by UserUPN;
let DeviceCounts = Activity
    | summarize DeviceCount = dcount(DeviceName) by UserUPN;
let ManagedStatus =
    union isfuzzy=true
        DeviceInfo,
        (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, DeviceName:string, OnboardingStatus:string) [])
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OnboardingStatus) by DeviceName;
ProjectUsers
| join kind=inner DeviceCounts on UserUPN
| join kind=inner LastDevice on UserUPN
| join kind=leftouter ManagedStatus on $left.LastSeenDevice == $right.DeviceName
| project UserUPN, Name, Project, DeviceCount, LastSeenDevice, LastSeen,
    ManagedStatus = iff(isempty(OnboardingStatus), "Unknown", OnboardingStatus)
| sort by LastSeen desc
content.title: Devices by Monitored User

content.json:
## Unmanaged Device Risk
> **Outcome this answers:** activity from unmanaged devices cannot be fully monitored and remains a residual risk, and this tab quantifies how much of monitored activity that is. `SigninLogs` requires Entra ID P1/P2; if absent, the Entra panels below will be empty and the MDE-based tile is the fallback signal.
>
> **Why device *name* and `TrustType`, not `isManaged`/`isCompliant`:** those two fields only populate when a device-based Conditional Access policy is actively enforcing them. Without that, every sign-in reads `false`/empty regardless of the device's real status, which silently understates risk rather than overstates it. `TrustType` (Azure AD joined / Hybrid Azure AD joined / registered / blank) is populated far more reliably and is what the table below and the second tile use instead.
>
> **Read the Entra-based tiles alongside the MDE-based one, not instead of it.** macOS browsers (Safari, Firefox) essentially never present device-trust claims during sign-in, even from a fully Intune-managed Mac, unless Platform SSO / an SSO browser extension is specifically configured. A population that signs in mostly via macOS browsers can show 0% Entra-trusted while still being genuinely MDE-managed at the endpoint level. See Setup → Step 3f/3g for how to confirm which case you're in.

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
let Activity =
    union isfuzzy=true
        DeviceNetworkEvents,
        (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
                   DeviceName:string) [])
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange}
    | extend UserUPN = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN)
    | join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
    | summarize Total = count() by DeviceName;
let ManagedStatus =
    union isfuzzy=true
        DeviceInfo,
        (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, DeviceName:string, OnboardingStatus:string) [])
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OnboardingStatus) by DeviceName;
Activity
| join kind=leftouter ManagedStatus on DeviceName
| extend Managed = OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"
| summarize TotalEvents = sum(Total), ManagedEvents = sumif(Total, Managed == true)
| extend ['Unmanaged Activity %'] = round(100.0 * (TotalEvents - ManagedEvents) / iff(TotalEvents == 0, 1, TotalEvents), 1)
| project ['Unmanaged Activity %']
content.title: Unmanaged Network Activity % (MDE-based)

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
union isfuzzy=true
    SigninLogs,
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, UserPrincipalName:string, DeviceDetail:dynamic,
               AppDisplayName:string) [])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend UserUPN = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
| extend TrustType = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType)
| summarize
    Total   = count(),
    Managed = countif(TrustType in ("Azure AD joined", "Hybrid Azure AD joined", "ServerAD joined"))
| extend ['Unregistered/Unknown Sign-in %'] = round(100.0 * (Total - Managed) / iff(Total == 0, 1, Total), 1)
| project ['Unregistered/Unknown Sign-in %']
content.title: Unregistered/Unknown Device Sign-in % (Entra-based)

content.json:
### Reconciling MDE-Known Devices with Entra Sign-in Trust
> These two signals measure different things and can legitimately disagree for the same person: **MDE-Known Device** is a fact about network/endpoint telemetry (does this person's last-seen device have the Defender for Endpoint sensor installed and reporting?). **Entra Device Trust** is a fact about the sign-in session (did the browser present an Entra device-trust token when authenticating?). A person can have a fully MDE-managed Windows machine and still show no Entra device trust, because their Microsoft 365 sign-ins happen from a separate, unmanaged device, or because the sign-in method they used (plain browser login, no Platform SSO / Enterprise SSO extension) never presents a device token regardless of the underlying device's real management status. Read this table per row, not the two tiles above in isolation.

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
let MDEActivity =
    union isfuzzy=true
        DeviceNetworkEvents,
        (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
                   DeviceName:string) [])
    | where Timestamp {TimeRange}
    | extend UserUPN = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN)
    | join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
    | summarize (LastSeen, LastSeenDevice) = arg_max(Timestamp, DeviceName) by UserUPN;
let MDEManagedStatus =
    union isfuzzy=true
        DeviceInfo,
        (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, DeviceName:string, OnboardingStatus:string) [])
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, OnboardingStatus) by DeviceName;
let MDEKnown =
    MDEActivity
    | join kind=leftouter MDEManagedStatus on $left.LastSeenDevice == $right.DeviceName
    | project UserUPN, MDEStatus = iff(isempty(OnboardingStatus), "Unknown", OnboardingStatus);
let EntraActivity =
    union isfuzzy=true
        SigninLogs,
        (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, UserPrincipalName:string, DeviceDetail:dynamic,
                   AppDisplayName:string) [])
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | extend UserUPN = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
    | join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
    | extend TrustType = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType)
    | summarize
        TotalSignIns   = count(),
        TrustedSignIns = countif(TrustType in ("Azure AD joined", "Hybrid Azure AD joined", "ServerAD joined"))
      by UserUPN;
ProjectUsers
| join kind=leftouter MDEKnown on UserUPN
| join kind=leftouter EntraActivity on UserUPN
| project
    UserUPN, Name, Project,
    ['MDE-Known Device'] = iff(isempty(MDEStatus), "No Network Activity Seen", MDEStatus),
    ['Entra Device Trust'] = case(
        isnull(TotalSignIns), "No Sign-ins Seen",
        TrustedSignIns > 0, "Yes",
        "No"),
    ['Entra Sign-ins (Trusted / Total)'] = iff(isnull(TotalSignIns), "-",
        strcat(tostring(coalesce(TrustedSignIns, 0)), " / ", tostring(TotalSignIns)))
| sort by Name asc
content.title: MDE-Known Device vs. Entra Device Trust, by User

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
union isfuzzy=true
    SigninLogs,
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, UserPrincipalName:string, DeviceDetail:dynamic,
               AppDisplayName:string) [])
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend UserUPN = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
| extend
    DeviceNameRaw = tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName),
    DeviceIdRaw   = tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId),
    DeviceOS      = tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem),
    DeviceBrowser = tostring(DeviceDetail.browser),
    TrustType     = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType)
| extend Device = case(
    isnotempty(DeviceNameRaw), DeviceNameRaw,
    isnotempty(DeviceIdRaw), DeviceIdRaw,
    isnotempty(DeviceOS) or isnotempty(DeviceBrowser),
        strcat(iff(isempty(DeviceOS), "Unknown OS", DeviceOS), " · ",
               iff(isempty(DeviceBrowser), "unknown browser", DeviceBrowser)),
    "(no device info returned)")
| extend Trust = iff(isempty(TrustType), "Unregistered / Unknown", TrustType)
| summarize
    SignIns  = count(),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserUPN, Name, Project, Device, Trust
| sort by LastSeen desc
content.title: Entra Sign-ins by Device (Monitored Users)

content.json: > **Residual risk statement:** activity from personal (unmanaged) devices, non-University networks, or Anthropic services embedded server-side within third-party products falls outside what this monitoring can see. Report the tiles above as supporting evidence for that statement, not as proof of full coverage.

## Setup & Validation
### Step 1: Create the watchlist
Sentinel → Watchlists → **+ New** → name it exactly `DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring`. Minimum columns: `UserUPN, Name, Project` (see `watchlists/DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring.csv`). SearchKey can be set to whatever you like; the workbook always resolves the real `UserUPN` column directly and only falls back to SearchKey if that column is missing.

> Optional: add `Status`, `DateAdded`, `DateRemoved` columns if you want the **Monitored User Coverage** tab to track *when* staff were added/removed, not just who's currently monitored. The workbook shipped here doesn't require them; this deployment's watchlist doesn't have them.

### Step 2: Analytics rule
The Detection Investigations tab and the Compliance Status/Investigations tiles filter `SecurityIncident` on `Title == "AFRL Anthropic Compliance"`. If your Sentinel analytics rule's display name (or `alertDisplayNameFormat` override, if it has one) is anything other than exactly `AFRL Anthropic Compliance`, update `RULE_TITLE` in `scripts/build_afrl_anthropic_workbook.py` and regenerate, otherwise those panels will silently show zero regardless of actual activity. `analytics-rules/afrl-anthropic-access-detection.json` is kept in the repo as a reference/backup ARM template (same title, same entity mappings), not required if you already have a rule deployed.

### Step 3: Validate data sources below

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN     = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name        = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project     = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        LastUpdated = column_ifexists('LastUpdatedTimeUTC', column_ifexists('TimeGenerated', datetime(null)))
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN);
ProjectUsers
| summarize TotalEntries = count(), LatestUpdate = max(LastUpdated)
content.title: Step 3a: DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring Watchlist Status

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    DeviceNetworkEvents,
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string,
               DeviceName:string) [])
| where Timestamp > ago(3d)
| summarize RowCount = count(), DistinctUsers = dcount(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn),
    LatestRecord = max(Timestamp)
content.title: Step 3b: DeviceNetworkEvents Status

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true SecurityIncident
| where Title == "AFRL Anthropic Compliance"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(395d)
| summarize TotalIncidents = dcount(IncidentNumber), LatestRecord = max(TimeGenerated)
content.title: Step 3c: SecurityIncident Rule Match Check

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    DeviceInfo,
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, DeviceName:string, OnboardingStatus:string) [])
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3d)
| summarize RowCount = count(), Onboarded = countif(OnboardingStatus == "Onboarded"),
    LatestRecord = max(TimeGenerated)
content.title: Step 3d: DeviceInfo Status (Known Devices tab)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    SigninLogs,
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, UserPrincipalName:string, DeviceDetail:dynamic,
               AppDisplayName:string) [])
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3d)
| summarize RowCount = count(), LatestRecord = max(TimeGenerated)
content.title: Step 3e: SigninLogs Status (Unmanaged Device Risk tab, requires Entra ID P1/P2)

content.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
union isfuzzy=true
    SigninLogs,
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, UserPrincipalName:string, DeviceDetail:dynamic,
               AppDisplayName:string) [])
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| extend UserUPN = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
| project TimeGenerated, UserUPN, AppDisplayName, DeviceDetail
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 30
content.title: Step 3f: Raw DeviceDetail Sample (diagnose Unmanaged Device Risk readings)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs,
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime) [])
| where TimeGenerated > ago(3d)
| summarize RowCount = count(), LatestRecord = max(TimeGenerated)
content.title: Step 3g: AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs Status (silent/WAM sign-ins, often where managed-device activity actually lands)

content.json:
> **Reading Step 3f:** `SigninLogs` only captures *interactive* sign-ins; a managed Windows device authenticating via Windows Hello/WAM does a lot of its Entra traffic as silent, non-interactive token refreshes, which land in `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs` instead. That table isn't being ingested in this workspace at all (Step 3g confirms `RowCount = 0`), so it can't be queried here; the Unmanaged Device Risk tab's Entra-based readings are built from `SigninLogs` alone, and Step 3f is what that data actually looks like.
>
> If Step 3f's `DeviceDetail` values are entirely macOS + Safari/Firefox with `isManaged:false`, `isCompliant:false`, and no `trustType`, that's expected and not a workbook bug: plain browser sign-ins on macOS essentially never carry Entra device-trust claims, managed or not, unless Platform SSO / an SSO browser extension is configured. Cross-check against the MDE-based tile and the Known Devices tab instead of treating this table as the sole managed-device signal for a macOS-heavy population.
>
> Separately: **MDE onboarding and Entra device registration are independent.** A device can have the Defender sensor installed without ever being registered as a trusted device in Entra ID (common when devices are on-prem domain-joined and onboarded to MDE via GPO/SCCM rather than through Entra hybrid join). If that's what's happening here, the registration gap itself is a residual-risk finding worth reporting on its own, separate from device-level BYOD risk. If `AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs` ever starts showing rows in Step 3g, that's a signal it's worth re-adding to the main queries.

---
### Notes

**Why the Anthropic domain list is hardcoded, not watchlist-driven:** this is the primary compliance control. A shared, general-purpose domain watchlist (like `AI-App-Domains` used elsewhere in this repo) can be edited for unrelated reasons by someone unaware of the compliance implication. The Anthropic domain list here is fixed in both the workbook and the analytics rule so the two can never drift out of sync with each other.

**Join case-sensitivity:** all UPN joins normalize both sides with `tolower()` before joining. KQL `join` is case-sensitive by default, and Defender/watchlist UPN casing isn't guaranteed to match.

**`DeviceNetworkEvents` uses `Timestamp`**, not `TimeGenerated`, in this tenant's schema (Defender Advanced Hunting naming), confirmed against a working hunting query before this workbook was built.

**Compliance exceptions** are tracked as a Sentinel incident label (`ComplianceException`) rather than a separate table; apply it when closing an incident that was reviewed and accepted as expected/approved activity.

**`SecurityIncident` queries are bounded to the last 395 days** before aggregating, to avoid an unbounded full-table scan (the same class of defect that throttled the DeviceInfo lookup on the Unmanaged Device Risk tab; see git history). 395 days exceeds the widest selectable Time Range option (365 days), so no incident a user can actually select into view is excluded by this bound.
